title: [review] project-LICHEN-5pe7: PRK derivation chain deviates from RFC 9528
description: In the EDHOC implementation, PRK_3e2m is just an alias for PRK_2e (`self._prk_3e2m = self._prk_2e`) and PRK_4e3m is an alias for PRK_3e2m. Per RFC 9528 sections 4.1.3.2-4.1.3.3, PRK_3e2m should be derived as EDHOC-KDF(PRK_2e, TH_2, "3e2m", ...) and PRK_4e3m as EDHOC-KDF(PRK_3e2m, TH_3, "4e3m", ...). The protocol still works because each KDF call uses distinct labels ("MAC_2", "K_3", etc.) and both initiator and responder implement the same shortcut, so interop is preserved. However, the test vector PRK values (prk_2e == prk_3e2m == prk_4e3m) are not byte-for-byte with a correct RFC 9528 implementation. Files: `python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py` lines 399, 432, 617, 683; `test/vectors/edhoc.json` lines 15-17.
